title: 2010 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: Alice needs to replace a light bulb located \(10\) centimeters below the ceiling in her kitchen. The ceiling is \(2.4\) meters above the floor. Alice is \(1.5\) meters tall and can reach \(46\) centimeters above the top of her head. Standing on a stool, she can just reach the light bulb. What is the height of the stool, in centimeters?

solutions.text: We know the height of the ceiling is \(2.4 \cdot 100 = 240\) cm. Subtracting out all the given values, we get \[ 240 - 150 - 46 - 10 = 34. \] Therefore, the height of the stool is \(34\) cm. Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The stool covers the remaining gap after Alice’s height, reach, and the bulb offset.
Convert the ceiling and Alice’s height to centimeters first.
